subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Workers replacing water pipes found old wooden pipes under a street.”?
options: After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things.
After residents worried about water quality, the town invited students to watch public testing.
The next day, more students brought different kinds of paper.
Students were invited to see them before they were removed.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After residents worried about water quality, the town invited students to watch public testing.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next day, more students brought different kinds of paper.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students were invited to see them before they were removed.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students were invited to see them before they were removed.」，答案為「Students were invited to see them before they were removed.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students were invited to see them before they were removed.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
